verdict.rationale: JumpCloud documents an official PowerShell module alongside its REST APIs for bulk operations across users, devices, and groups (jumpcloud-docs-3), which is a first-party client library. It also publishes an API 2.0 spec (jumpcloud-docs-25). The GitHub support repo only offers helper scripts and API examples, not SDKs (jumpcloud-gh-1). missing for 10: evidence of official multi-language SDKs (e.g. Python, Go, JS), SDK reference documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.
